verdict.rationale: Cline's authorization docs list Bring Your Own Key as an option alongside signing in to a Cline account, and the pricing page confirms you can use your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or other provider keys, which avoids Cline account-based billing. The Cline-provider page frames sign-in as an alternative to managing separate API keys, so key-based use is presented as a distinct path. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no Cline account login is needed at all when using BYOK, documented API-key setup for headless or CLI use, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): use your own provider credentials (cloud or local runtimes).
You can bring your own API keys from providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others.
Instead of managing separate API keys across multiple vendors, you sign in once, add Cline credits, and select from available models directly in Cline.
